Monetary Policy Report

24 July 2026

Inflation

CPI inflation is projected to average 2.2 per cent in 2026. Inflation is well anchored around the 2 per cent control range.

Economic outlook

GDP growth is expected to average 1.5 per cent in 2026. Economic activity is expected to strengthen in the second half of the year.

Risks

The risks around the inflation outlook are tilted to the upside. Geopolitical tensions remain a key source of uncertainty.

Forward guidance

The Bank will continue to assess the data. The Bank will adjust policy as needed.
